Subject: Re: ZenData onboarding - witness test request

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the onboarding runbook yesterday. Before we sign off internally, Procurement and Engineering want a short witnessed benchmark that shows stability & throughput with our typical workload. Can you confirm you can run a supervised test (we'll have an engineer on call) and produce the artifacts below?

What we need:
- A short witnessed load run (60min sustained + two 5m spike windows).
- Per-route metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, QPS, error rate, and tokens/sec.
- KV/prefix cache warmup evidence and difference before/after.
- Exported logs/traces and a CSV of request samples mapped to response latencies.

Targets we care about (initial):
- p95 generation latency <= 350ms for typical prompt (~300-600 tokens).
- Sustained throughput: ~150 rps for the production model variant we discussed.
- Error rate < 0.5% (5xx / timeouts) during baseline window.

I've attached a small sample of queries and our acceptance spreadsheet (see attachments). Procurement is CC'd for timeline/contract questions. Can you propose two windows this week (PST) and what you need from our side?

Cheers,
Olivia Chen
Head of ML Ops, ZenData
olivia.chen@zendata.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: ZenData onboarding - witness test request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and the sample queries. We can absolutely run a witnessed session and deliver the artifacts you listed. Proposed plan below; I've attached a short plan PDF with the same steps.

High-level witness plan (v1):
1) Prep (30m)
   - Confirm endpoint + model variant (you mentioned "zen-prod-v2-512"), API keys, and a short allowlist of IPs for the test runner.
   - Load sample set into replay harness and seed prefix cache (warmup run).
2) Baseline run (60m sustained)
   - Synthetic replay of your sample queries at target sustain (~150 rps).
   - Record p50/p95/p99, token throughput, GPU utilization, and per-request traces.
3) Spike windows (2 x 5m)
   - Short bursts to 250rps to observe tail latency and autoscaling/fallback behavior.
4) Post-run analysis (2-3h)
   - Produce CSV of samples -> latencies, aggregated dashboard screenshots, and a short summary of pass/fail vs your acceptance sheet.

Proposed acceptance criteria (recommended):
- p95 latency <= 350ms (pass), <= 450ms (warn), >450ms (fail)
- Sustained throughput +/-10% of target (pass if within)
- Error rate <0.5% (pass)
- No model fallback events during the baseline window (warn/fail depending)

Operational notes / what we need from you: 
- Final confirmation of model name and the endpoint URL (we need the exact host).
- A short list of test accounts/API keys or an allowlist for our runner.
- Point-of-contact on your side to confirm/stop the run (name & mobile).

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue, Dec 1 — 14:30–16:00 PST (we can do prep at 14:00)
- Wed, Dec 2 — 09:00–10:30 PST

Attachments: redwood-witness-plan-v1.pdf
Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/onboarding/zen-benchmarks

I'll coordinate a short bridge during the run and will loop in Marissa for the acceptance note and Dev for the runner. If those windows work, I'll schedule and confirm credentials/config details in a follow up.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
